steps.title: Prepare Sample Labels
steps.instruction: Print the required labels for Bray extraction for each site, depth, and replicate.

steps.title: Weigh Soil Samples
steps.instruction: Weigh out 3 g of soil into labeled 50 mL centrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Add Extraction Solution
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL of Olsen Extract solution to the tubes using a pipet and electronic pipettor.

steps.title: Mix and Shake Samples
steps.instruction: Cap the samples, shake to mix, and place them in a foam block on the shaker.

substeps.instruction: Shake samples at 1 rpm for 1 minute.

steps.title: Centrifuge Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at 4000 rpm for 8 minutes.

steps.title: Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Pour off the liquid into a clean and labeled 50 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Store or Filter Extracts
steps.instruction: Either filter the extracts immediately following the sample filtering protocol or store them in the freezer.

substeps.instruction: If unable to filter immediately, freeze samples on their side in the -20 °C freezer (Staging Freezer 2) bottom shelf to prevent tube breaking.
